mechanism_reason: The baseline reveals how serious harm can arise before automation. Named algorithmic cases are used to test whether automation makes the same exertion faster, more scalable, less contextual and more difficult to attribute—not to rewrite the baseline.
permitted_join: Chloe Moffat remains the named non-AI adverse-process baseline. Wave 03 may compare transaction states such as notice, context, support, interim restriction, human judgment, explanation and reconciliation, but may not infer that AI or algorithmic management was used in her case.
prohibited_inferences: an algorithm generated or escalated the anonymous complaint
a model caused the access restriction or support denial
her response demonstrates weakness or defective character
a named Wave 03 company or platform is causally equivalent to the Treasury process
